statement.en: This level is set in Halifax. Kwilmu'kw Maw-klusuaqn works under the direction of the Assembly of Nova Scotia Mi'kmaw Chiefs. It says the Mi'kmaq have never given up, handed over or sold title to any of their lands, and that their title claim covers all the land in Nova Scotia. It hopes the Mi'kmaq of Nova Scotia can at last put into practice the rights from the treaties their ancestors signed in the 1700s.
statement.fr: Ce niveau se déroule à Halifax. Kwilmu'kw Maw-klusuaqn travaille sous la direction de l'Assembly of Nova Scotia Mi'kmaw Chiefs. L'organisme affirme que les Mi'kmaq n'ont jamais abandonné, cédé ni vendu le titre sur aucune de leurs terres, et que leur revendication de titre couvre toutes les terres de la Nouvelle-Écosse. Il espère que les Mi'kmaq de la Nouvelle-Écosse pourront enfin mettre en œuvre les droits issus des traités que leurs ancêtres ont signés dans les années 1700.

source.quote: Mi’kmaq have never surrendered, ceded, or sold the Aboriginal Title to any of our lands. We have a Title claim to all lands in Nova Scotia.

verification.evidence: Unlike later treaties signed in other parts of Canada, the Peace and Friendship Treaties did not involve First Nations surrendering rights to the lands and resources they had traditionally used and occupied.

nationSource.publisher: Kwilmu'kw Maw-klusuaqn, the Mi'kmaq Rights Initiative of the Assembly of Nova Scotia Mi'kmaw Chiefs

blurb.en: Halifax elected the first representative assembly in Canada, in 1758. Government by election grew here slowly and without war.
blurb.fr: Halifax a élu la première assemblée représentative au Canada, en 1758. Ici, le gouvernement élu s'est développé lentement et sans guerre.

source.quote: Democratic institutions developed gradually and peacefully. The first representative assembly was elected in Halifax, Nova Scotia, in 1758.

verification.evidence: The Beginnings of Democracy Democratic institutions developed gradually and peacefully. The first representative assembly was elected in Halifax, Nova Scotia, in 1758. Prince Edward Island followed in 1773, New Brunswick in 1785.

blurb.en: Taking responsibility for yourself and your family is a responsibility of citizenship. Getting a job, caring for your family and working hard are important Canadian values.
blurb.fr: Prendre soin de soi et de sa famille est une responsabilité de la citoyenneté. Trouver un emploi, prendre soin de sa famille et travailler fort sont des valeurs canadiennes importantes.

source.quote: Taking responsibility for oneself and one's family — Getting a job, taking care of one's family and working hard in keeping with one's abilities are important Canadian values.

verification.evidence: Citizenship Responsibilities In Canada, rights come with responsibilities. These include: … Taking responsibility for oneself and one’s family — Getting a job, taking care of one’s family and working hard in keeping with one’s abilities are important Canadian values.

blurb.en: People often call Canada a land of immigrants. In the past two hundred years, millions of people have come here, and they helped build this country and defend it.
blurb.fr: On dit souvent du Canada que c'est une terre d'immigration. Depuis deux cents ans, des millions de personnes sont venues s'y établir, et elles ont aidé à bâtir le pays et à le défendre.

source.quote: Canada is often referred to as a land of immigrants because, over the past 200 years, millions of newcomers have helped to build and defend our way of life.

verification.evidence: The majority of Canadians were born in this country and this has been true since the 1800s. However, Canada is often referred to as a land of immigrants because, over the past 200 years, millions of newcomers have helped to build and defend our way of life.

blurb.en: Halifax is Canada's largest port on the east coast. It is deep-water and ice-free, and it has long mattered to Atlantic trade and to defence.
blurb.fr: Halifax est le plus grand port de la côte est du Canada. Il est en eau profonde et libre de glace, et il compte depuis longtemps pour le commerce de l'Atlantique et pour la défense.

source.quote: As Canada's largest east coast port, deep-water and ice-free, the capital, Halifax, has played an important role in Atlantic trade and defence and is home to Canada's largest naval base.

verification.evidence: Nova Scotia is the most populous Atlantic Province, with a rich history as the gateway to Canada. Known for the world’s highest tides in the Bay of Fundy, the province’s identity is linked to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping. As Canada’s largest east coast port, deep-water and ice-free, the capital, Halifax, has played an important role in Atlantic trade and defence and is home to Canada’s largest naval base.
